applicationFee.note: International fee; domestic fee $60. Waivers limited to current Auburn graduate students enrolled in graduate courses, full-time Auburn employees, active-duty military with confirmation, and second application to approved dual program. Select eligible category and supply documentation. International eligibility for a particular route must be confirmed; no general hardship waiver established.

requirements.note: GRE required unless waived by faculty. Prospective students should identify a faculty member who will support their application before applying. Bachelor-equivalent required centrally; recommendation count and further program documents were not established from the opened page.

funding.note: Program lists an undated PhD assistantship range of $20,484–$27,500 for0.5FTE and12 months, at department discretion and subject to change. No all-student award or international funding guarantee established.
